store.title: Store Settings
store.seo_subtitle: Search engine and social media settings
store.meta_title_placeholder: Page title shown in browser tabs and search results
store.meta_desc_placeholder: Brief description shown in search results (max 500 chars)...
store.announcement_placeholder: e.g. Free shipping on orders over 5000 دج
store.announcement_hint: Leave empty to hide the announcement bar
store.save_error: Failed to save. Please try again.
store.reviews_subtitle: Allow customers to submit and view product reviews
store.reviews_enabled_hint: When enabled, customers can submit reviews and they appear on product pages
store.tracking_subtitle: Pixels and server-side conversions for your ad platforms
store.tracking_enabled_hint: When disabled, no pixel loads and no server-side conversion is sent, for any platform
store.tracking_pixel_id_hint: Found in Meta Events Manager → Data Sources
store.tracking_token_hint: Server-side token — never exposed to visitors. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
store.tracking_ad_account_hint: Your own label for the Meta ad account — for reference only
store.tracking_event_description: Choose which stage of your COD fulfillment funnel triggers the Meta Pixel & Conversions API event. This defines how Meta optimizes your ad spend.
store.tracking_event_purchase_instant_label: Instant Purchase — at checkout (Recommended for Meta Ads)
store.tracking_event_purchase_instant_hint: Fires Purchase immediately upon checkout with order total and deduplication ID. Essential for Facebook Ads real-time conversion optimization.
store.tracking_event_purchase_confirmed_hint: Fires Purchase only when your call center confirms the order with the customer. Filters out 100% of fake leads while staying within Meta's 24h attribution window.
store.tracking_event_purchase_delivered_hint: Optimizes toward delivered orders. For selected remote areas, the event may be sent when delivery begins to account for longer delivery transit times.
store.tracking_event_lead_hint: Fires a Lead event immediately upon order placement. Select this if your Meta ad campaign optimizes for Leads instead of Purchases.
store.tracking_test_mode_hint: Meta and TikTok conversions go to their test stream (with the test event code) instead of production measurement
store.tracking_test_mode_warning: Test mode is on — events are not counted for real measurement. Turn it off before going live.
store.tracking_test_code_hint: From Events Manager → Test Events — used while test mode is on, and by the test button below
store.otp_enabled_hint: Customers receive a code on WhatsApp before placing an order
store.otp_key_hint: Created at app.dzverify.com/api-keys — shown once at creation
store.otp_language_hint: The language the verification code is sent in
store.otp_check_no_credits: Balance exhausted — top up at app.dzverify.com.
store.otp_check_failed: Could not reach dzverify — try again
store.turnstile_subtitle: Bot protection for the checkout order form
store.turnstile_enabled_hint: Customers pass an invisible challenge before ordering (shows only when Cloudflare needs to verify)
store.turnstile_site_key_hint: Public key from your Turnstile widget (Cloudflare dashboard)
store.turnstile_secret_key_hint: Used to verify tokens server-side — never shown to customers, never sent to the browser
store.turnstile_hostname_hint: Your storefront domain must be added to the widget's allowed hostnames in the Cloudflare dashboard
store.bot_protection_subtitle: Cloudflare Turnstile — protect the checkout order form from bots
store.email_subtitle: Transactional emails via Sendili (team invites, password resets)
store.email_enabled_hint: When on, CodFlow sends transactional email (invites, password resets) through Sendili.
store.email_key_hint: Create an API key in your Sendili dashboard after verifying your sending domain.
store.email_from_hint: The sending address — its domain must be verified in your Sendili workspace.
store.email_domains_hint: Verified domains load automatically once a key is added — or use Test connection to refresh them.
store.email_check_no_credits: Out of credits — top up at sendili.com.
store.api_key_subtitle: Read-only key used by your storefront to authenticate with the API
store.api_key_missing: API key not available. It will appear here after your next re-deployment.
store.delivery_pricing_subtitle: Free-delivery threshold and how a multi-product basket is charged
store.free_shipping_threshold_hint: Orders at or above this subtotal ship free. Leave empty for no free delivery.
store.free_shipping_threshold_invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty to turn this off.
store.cart_shipping_mode_label: Basket with items from different shipping profiles
store.cart_shipping_mode_hint: Only applies when a basket mixes products that ship differently. A single-product order is unaffected.
store.cart_shipping_mode_highest_label: Charge the highest rate in the basket
store.cart_shipping_mode_highest_hint: The customer pays the rate of the item that costs most to ship. Your margin is never reduced by a cheaper item.
store.cart_shipping_mode_default_profile_hint: Per-product shipping profiles are ignored for baskets. Simplest promise if everything ships the same way.
store.cart_subtitle: Let customers order several products in one go
store.cart_enabled_hint: Off by default. Your storefront keeps its one-click order form either way.
store.cart_enabled_note: "Add to cart" appears next to your order form — it does not replace it. Customers buying a single product keep the same one-step checkout. A customer with several products confirms them together on a checkout page.
store.tracking_per_page_hint: Let an individual landing page report to its own pixel instead of this one. While this is off, every page uses the pixel above.
store.tracking_per_page_next_step: Now open a landing page in the Studio and give it its own pixel. Pages you don't change keep using the store pixel.
store.branding_moved: Logo, colours and font are now edited in the design editor, with a preview, and applied when you publish.
store.domain_moved: Domains are managed on the Domains page: add, verify and choose the primary one.
store.tracking_consent_hint: Shows a banner on this channel. No pixel loads and no server-side conversion is sent until the visitor accepts.
store.tracking_tiktok_pixel_hint: TikTok Events Manager → your web pixel (20 letters and digits)
store.tracking_tiktok_test_code_hint: Events Manager → Test events — used while test mode is on, and by the test button below
store.tracking_snap_pixel_hint: Snap Events Manager → your pixel (looks like 1a2b3c4d-…)
store.tracking_ga4_id_hint: Admin → Data streams → your web stream (G-XXXXXXXXXX)
store.tracking_ga4_secret_hint: Your web stream → Measurement Protocol API secrets. Leave empty to keep the stored secret.
store.tracking_gads_label_hint: From the same tag — the part after the slash
store.tracking_secret_hint: Server-side secret — never shown to visitors. Leave empty to keep the stored one.
store.tracking_server_side_note: Fires in the browser and from our server; the order id keeps one conversion per order.
store.tracking_browser_only_note: Fires in the browser only, with the order id so a conversion is never counted twice.
store.tracking_invalid_id: {field}: this does not look like a valid identifier
store.tracking_diag_subtitle: Check your credentials and follow the latest server-side conversions
store.tracking_diag_test_code_missing: Add the test event code and save first — Meta and TikTok receive test events in their test stream only.
store.tracking_diag_not_configured: Save this platform's ID and token first.
store.tracking_diag_test_error: The test could not be sent. Try again.
store.tracking_diag_load_failed: The latest conversions could not be loaded.
store.tracking_diag_empty: No server-side conversion yet. They appear here as orders come in.
store.tracking_diag_skip_no_access_token: Not sent: no access token is saved for this platform
store.tracking_diag_skip_not_configured: Not sent: the platform was removed or the conversion event changed
store.tracking_diag_skip_event_time_expired: Not sent: older than the platform accepts (7 days)
store.order_limit_subtitle: Stops fake and duplicate orders from the same person
store.order_limit_label: One order per phone or device every (minutes)
store.order_limit_hint: 10 by default. 0 turns the limit off.
store.order_limit_note: A blocked order sees the usual confirmation, so a script learns nothing. Nothing is created; you find the attempt under Orders → Blocked attempts, where you can also block a phone for all your channels.
store.order_limit_invalid: Enter a number of minutes between 0 and 1440.
store.aventy_subtitle: This channel's connection to Aventy: its key, and what was last pulled from it.
store.aventy_key_hint: Create the key for this channel in Aventy and paste it here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again; saving a new key replaces the previous one.
store.aventy_key_placeholder: Paste the key created in Aventy
store.aventy_key_none: No key yet: this channel is not connected to Aventy.
store.aventy_revoked: Aventy refused this channel's key on {date}. Orders are kept and wait in the transmission queue; paste a new key to resume.
store.aventy_not_configured: This platform has no encryption key for Aventy keys yet (AVENTY_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY), so a key cannot be saved.
store.aventy_sync_hint: Checked every minute; only what changed in Aventy is pulled.

shipping.title: Shipping Rates
shipping.subtitle: Set delivery fees per wilaya for home delivery and stop-desk pickup
shipping.no_profile_description: Create a shipping profile to set per-wilaya delivery rates. These rates will be auto-suggested when creating new orders.
shipping.success_default: Set as the account default profile
shipping.confirm_delete: Delete this profile and all its rates?
shipping.set_as_default_hint: Used by every store that has not chosen its own profile, on its storefront and for new orders.
shipping.linked_company_hint: Associate this rate card with a specific delivery company
shipping.fetch_error_not_connected: This company is not connected — add API credentials first
shipping.import_company_rates_hint: Fill the table below with this company's pricing data
shipping.import_no_pricing: This company has no pricing data to import
shipping.list_empty_description: Create a rate card to define per-wilaya delivery prices for your drivers and companies.
shipping.store_default_hint: Shipping profiles and their rates belong to your account and are shared by all your stores. Choose which one this store uses by default.
shipping.store_default_saved: This store’s default profile was saved
shipping.store_default_failed: The profile could not be saved. Try again.
